user.description: Up to four API keys: enter values directly OR the names of entries in /config/secrets.yaml (do not mix).

error.required: At least one API key is required.
error.choose_key_source: Choose either direct keys or secret names.

init.title: Automatic weather updates
init.description: Select up to four full-hour times (HH:00). The API request starts 5 minutes earlier, and sensor values publish at the hour. Empty slots disable fetching. Respect API quotas; manual updates remain available. Optional: enter secret names to use secrets.yaml instead of previously entered API keys.

error.invalid_time: Use a full hour in HH:00 format.
error.invalid_secrets: Secret reference missing, invalid, or secrets.yaml could not be read.
